summary: Expand D3D9 live SM3 indexed/nonindexed instanced line strips, triangle strips, and fans into a single native indexed GPU draw with precise primitive winding and boundaries; DX9Ex fallback remains opt-in safe.

feature_contract.goal: All real game SM3 16-stream instanced strip/fan sources keep per-instance topology and draw on one GPU indexed batch while preserving fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Native single DrawIndexed for indexed and nonindexed D3D9 strips and fans without connecting adjacent instances
Odd/even triangle-strip winding and fan center, line segments and source per-instance vertex attributes remain unchanged
Invalid source indices, count/byte overflow and unsupported topology are rejected without corrupting prior list indices; original renderer and input/FFB untouched
Bounded portable C++ connected-instance positive/negative regressions and all mandatory exact-SHA GitHub Gates

integration_path: Intercept actual game D3D9 programmable SM3 instanced VB/IB/UP
Build per-instance ordered index geometry preserving strip/fan topology
Submit native D3D11 DrawIndexed with original D3D9 fallback

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Per-instance 16-stream source plus strip parity/triangle fan and line segments
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Invalid indices, overflow, unsupported source and transactional buffer preservation
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Source instance streaming -> topology-index assembly -> native IA DrawIndexed

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native opt-in; original D3D9 Draw/Present/gamepad/FFB unchanged; DXVK frozen

REAL_GAME_DRAW_BLOCKER: Quest3/VDXR live visual evidence not yet observed
NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_ACTION: Review GitHub exact-SHA gate, repair only evidenced failures; separate game/HMD runtime.

connected.evidence: Portable topology helper local C++ passed; full SM3 bridge requires Windows/GitHub Gate.

winding.evidence: Generated index parity and source-instance bounds checked in bounded probe.

fallback.evidence: Negative source and preserved legacy non-instanced path.

c6_bookkeeping_note: C6 result-only [skip ci]; original feature_contract, acceptance_results and material_result_sha preserved unchanged. Exact validation-bearing source SHA unchanged; no source edits, CI rerun or duplicate score.
